body: OutKast vs Ovrkast? The case being taken to federal court in Georgia claims that Outkast had asked Ovrkast to change his name and that he ignored the deal. According the report: “The duo’s trademark company High Schoolers LLC accuses the artist of trademark infringement, unfair competition and breaching an agreement requiring him to abandon OVRKAST by July 15. ” this is a developing story and we will keep you updated. Allegations are not findings of guilt.

OutKast vs Ovrkast? 🤔 

The case being taken to federal court in Georgia claims that Outkast had asked Ovrkast to change his name and that he ignored the deal.

According the report: “The duo’s trademark company High Schoolers LLC accuses the artist of trademark infringement, unfair competition and breaching an agreement requiring him to abandon OVRKAST by July 15. Outkast claims Wilson accepted OVERKXST (O-V-E-R-K-X-S-T) as his replacement stage name but then delayed the paperwork and proposed two previously rejected alternatives.”

this is a developing story and we will keep you updated. But what do you think of this?
